lines.greeting_1: Oh, there you are. It's lovely to see you.
lines.greeting_2: Welcome back. Come, rest a little.
lines.encourage_1: One little step at a time. You're doing so well.
lines.encourage_2: Take your time. I'll be right here.
lines.gift_1: Here, I saved a little something for you. I hope it helps.
lines.gift_2: You've been working so hard. This one's for you.
lines.rank_1: Look at you! A new rank. I'm so proud of you.
lines.rank_2: You did it! I knew you would. Shall we celebrate?
